forms.gloss: small stick; bit of wood; fiber or vein of a leaf; bit of a stem or haulm; small stick used for writing
fiber or vein of a leaf; very small stick
stick (especially of metal), bar, ingot, slate pencil

records.comparison_or_correction_text: Ka. and Kod. were included in DBIA 68, < Skt. kaṣṭha-; only items with t/tt rather than ḍḍ clearly belong there. Turner CDIAL 3120 has th/tth. Turner puts Mar. kaḍī in no. 3017 *kata-. Is it possible that the Dravidian words are of Dravidian origin, perhaps DED 1155?
records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S3 Ka. kaddi small stick, bit of wood, fiber or vein of a leaf, bit of a stem or a haulm, small stick used for writing. Kod. kaddi small stick, bit of wood. Tu. kaddi the fiber or vein of a leaf, a very small stick. Te. kaddi stick (esp. of metal), bar, ingot, slate pencil. /Cf. Mar. kaḍī (Master, OMar., p. 107) match-stick, (Turner) little stick, blade of grass. Ka. and Kod. were included in DBIA 68, < Skt. kaṣṭha- ... perhaps DED 1155?
DBIA S4 Ka. galla, galle cheek. Kod. gala id. Tu. galla lower part of the cheek. Te. gallamu cheek. Pe. gala id. Kui gada id. Kuwi (P.) gala id. /Turner, CDIAL, no. 4089 galla-.

forms.gloss: musical instrument smaller than vīṇai, with two steel strings
two-stringed bamboo instrument fitted with gourds
musical instrument made of reeds played with the fingers

records.comparison_or_correction_text: < Skt. kimnara-, kimnari-. Cf. Mayrhofer; Turner CDIAL 3145 (especially Mar. kinri).
records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S5 Ta. kinnari a musical instrument, smaller than the vīṇai, having two steel strings; kinnaram a kind of lute. Ma. kinnari a lute made from gourds. Ka. kinnari the lute of the caṇḍālas. Tu. kinnari lute, fiddle. Te. kinnara, kinnera a kind of lute. Pa. kindri a kind of string instrument. Kuwi (F.) kineri guitar (two-stringed with stops). Kur. kendra a two-stringed bamboo instrument fitted with gourds. Malt. kōndre musical instrument made of reeds played with the fingers. / < Skt. kimnara-, kimnari-.
DBIA S6 Go. (Ko.) kustir kind of rat (ghus musa) (Voc. 811). Konda (BB) kusturi elka muskrat. /Skt. kasturi- musk.

DBIA S7 Go. (F-H. G.) koji footprint; (SR.) kojji leg; kojji (Ph.) sign, (Mu. Ma.) footprint; (Ch.) koj, (Ko.) gonju footprint (Voc. 878). Kui koja footprint, track. Kuwi (Su. P.) kojja footprint; (S.) koza (z = j) foot. /Turner, CDIAL, no. 3929 *khōjja-.

records.comparison_or_correction_text: Halbi kog; Turner CDIAL 3481 kōka- (meaning given as wolf, but Burrow 1967, p. 40, argues for wild dog).
records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S8 Konda (B.) kōg wild dog. Pe. kōg nekur id. /Halbi kog id. Turner, CDIAL, no. 3481 kōka- (meaning given as wolf, but Burrow 1967, p. 40, argues for wild dog).
DBIA S9 Kui (K.) jaggu cloud. Kuwi (Su. P. S.) hagu, (F.) hagu id.; (F.) hagi sky. / < Pkt. sagga- (< Skt. svarga-).
DBIA S10 Ka. jibaru gummy excretion of the eye. Go. (Ko.) jibri rheum of the eye (Voc. 1422). /Turner, CDIAL, no. 4819 *cippa-.

records.comparison_or_correction_text: < IA (see e.g. Molesworth under sumar < Pers. sumar).
records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S11 Ta. (coll.) cumār about, approximately; moderate, fair. Ma. sumāru about, average. Ko. cuma-rm about. To. sumo'r approximation to, about. Ka. sumāra, sumāru nearness, aboutness, about. Kod. sumā'ri some (distance), about. Tu. sumāri middling, moderate, about. / < IA (see e.g. Molesworth under sumar < Pers. sumar).

forms.gloss: any tubular vessel of the body

records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S12 Ta. cirai nerve, tendon, vein, artery. Ka. sere vein, artery. Tu. (Manner, English-Tulu Dictionary) turu vein. Te. sira any tubular vessel of the body. Kol. si'ram (pl. si'ral) tendon, nerve, blood-vessel. Nk. sira (pl. -l) vein. Go. (Tr. W. Ph.) cira, (A. Mu. Ma.) sira, (Y.) sir (pl. -k) nerve, vein, pulse (Voc. 1332). Konda sira vein; (BB) sire nerve. Pe. cira vein. Kuwi (Su. P.) hīru (pl. hirka) id. Kur. sir nerve, vein, muscle, fiber (of flax, pulses, etc.). /Turner, CDIAL, no. 13421 sirā-.

records.comparison_or_correction_text: < Mar. daraḍ, darḍi steep slope, high bank. Turner CDIAL 6191.
records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S13 Kol. (SR.) dardi bank. Pa. (S.) daddi bank of a river. Go. (L.) dadi bank, brink, brim (Voc. 1833). / < Mar. daraḍ, darḍi steep slope, high bank. Turner, CDIAL, no. 6191.

forms.gloss: fall of the dice; cubical pieces in dice-play; number one in dice; good opportunity

records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S14 Ta. tāyam a fall of the dice, cubical pieces in dice-play, number one in the game of dice; good opportunity. Ma. tāyam a die; opportunity. Ka. daya a throw at dice; opportunity. /Turner, CDIAL, no. 6258 dātu- (cf. H. daur).

DBIA S15 Ta. tinam day. Ko. jinm (obl. jint-) day, weather; jinta'rm daily. To. sinm (obl. sint-) day (in songs: aro sinm sixty days; sinm doposy not postponing it for a day). Ka. dina, jina day. Badaga jena id. / < Skt. dina- day.

forms.gloss: caste of rope-dancers, tumblers, and acrobats

records.raw_entry_text: DBIA S16 Tu. dombe, dommare a tumbler, rope-dancer. Te. dommara caste of rope-dancers, tumblers, and acrobats; dommari man of that caste. Go. (Ko.) domar conjuror (Voc. 1614). /Turner, CDIAL, no. 5570 d.mba-.
